claims.claim: exp-005 used llm-jp/llm-jp-instructions as the Japanese calibration and evaluation source.
All exp-005 NVFP4 variants had higher NLL than the base model on both English and Japanese evaluation text.
Japanese calibration was the best quantized variant on LLM-jp Japanese evaluation text.
Bilingual mixed calibration was slightly best among quantized variants on English evaluation text.
claims.notes: Gap to English-only calibration is small.
